token.title: Excalidraw+ API key
token.description: Only needed for `scene:` fences. Create it in your Excalidraw+ workspace settings. A personal key starts with `uk-`. Stored in the OS keychain, never in the workspace.

theme.title: Default theme
theme.description: Theme a fence uses when it does not set one itself. `auto` follows the client's colour scheme.

maxHeight.title: Maximum height (px)
maxHeight.description: Tallest a rendered scene may get before it scales down to fit. A fence can set its own `height:`.

indexPage.title: Scene index page
indexPage.description: Page slug the "list scenes into a page" command writes to.
